newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-WP BAT FIRST AGAINST NORTHERN TRANSVAAL.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-WP BAT FIRST AGAINST NORTHERN TRANSVAAL.

text.p: Western Province captain John Commins won the toss and elected to bat on the opening day of his side's Super Sport Series four-day match against Northern Transvaal at Newlands on Friday.
Western Province - Sven Koenig, Ryan Maron, Desmond Haynes, HD Ackerman, John Commins (captain), Eric Simons, Dave Rundle, Paul Kirsten, Meyrick Pringle, Aubrey Martyn, Brett Schultz.
Northern Transvaal - Andre Seymore, Roy Pienaar, Richie Richardson (captain), Mike Rindel, Dan van Zyl, Martin van Jaarsveld, Nico Martin, Steve Elworthy, Ivan Pistorius, Greg Smith, Rudi Bryson.
